name: Parul Kumari
title: UI/UX & Graphic Designer
summary: Innovative UI/UX and Graphic Designer with a passion for digital concept arts and frontend web design. Enjoys crafting delightful and intuitive user interfaces, working collaboratively, and bringing ideas to life. Prioritizes simple content structure, elegant design patterns, and engaging user interactions.
about: Hi! My name is Parul Kumari. I'm a UI/UX designer and digital visual artist. I love creating things that exist on the internet. With a passion for detail and creativity, I specialize in crafting user-centered designs that deliver impactful visual solutions.

I'm currently working on some exciting projects and have previously had the opportunity to collaborate with Design Koktail, Simmi Foundation, and Bharat Tex, where I took on a variety of roles, from graphic design to video editing and visual merchandising.

Currently, I'm pursuing a Bachelor of Design (B.Des) from National Institute of Fashion Technology, where I am further developing my skills. I enjoy collaborating with teams and working independently, always striving to push the boundaries of design.

experience.description: As a UI/UX Designer at Imarti Media, I create modern, intuitive, and visually engaging digital experiences. I focus on user-centered design, clean interfaces, thoughtful interactions, and responsive experiences while collaborating with teams to turn ideas into impactful digital products.

Works as a UI/UX Designer, focused on crafting user-centered digital experiences that are both visually appealing and highly functional. Involves understanding user needs, translating them into intuitive interfaces, and collaborating closely with developers and product teams to deliver seamless designs. Specializes in creating wireframes, interactive prototypes, and polished UI designs while ensuring accessibility and responsiveness across platforms.

Contributed to the website redesign of MR Button, designed the website for their sister brand Monteil, and created graphics for their upcoming t-shirt collections. Also developed banners and social media posts to support their digital marketing campaigns.

Provided tailored design solutions for various clients, specializing in graphic design and UI/UX development. Created visually compelling graphics and intuitive user interfaces that enhance user experience and engagement. Collaborated closely with clients to understand their vision and deliver high-quality designs on time.

Assisted in the development of visual content for marketing and promotional materials. Collaborated with the design team to create engaging graphics and layouts, enhancing brand visibility across various platforms.

Assisted in creating visually appealing displays to enhance product visibility and customer engagement. Collaborated with the team to design and implement merchandising strategies that aligned with seasonal themes and promotions.

Developed innovative visual concepts and designs for a variety of projects, including branding, marketing materials, and digital content. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure design alignment with client goals and brand identity.

Developed visually compelling graphics and edited engaging video content for promotional campaigns. Collaborated with the creative team to create cohesive branding materials aligned with marketing objectives.

Created impactful visual content for marketing campaigns and promotional materials, supporting the foundation's mission. Collaborated with team members to develop graphics that effectively communicated messages and engaged the community.
